_about: Labeled role/resume relevance benchmark for evaluating retrieval + scoring. Resumes are SYNTHETIC (no real PII). Labels: strong = clear fit, moderate = partial/adjacent fit, weak = not a fit. 5 roles, 16 resumes, 40 labeled pairs.

roles.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
roles.description: Build production RAG and NLP systems. Python, transformers, vector search, LLM fine-tuning, and strong software engineering.

roles.title: Backend Software Engineer
roles.description: Design REST APIs and microservices. Python or Java, PostgreSQL, Docker, async, and distributed systems.

roles.title: Frontend Engineer
roles.description: Build web UIs with React and TypeScript. CSS, accessibility, state management, and web performance.

roles.title: Data Scientist
roles.description: Statistical modeling and ML. Python, pandas, scikit-learn, SQL, experimentation, and data visualization.

roles.title: DevOps / SRE Engineer
roles.description: Operate cloud infrastructure. Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD, AWS, monitoring, and reliability.
